subject: Re: Obsidian status: pilot decision
body:
Team,

Decision on the pilot, based on Wei's coverage analysis.

We run the May 18 pilot on the two catalog localization pairs only, and KoBE ships as part of a composite: entity-grounding score from KoBE plus the existing fluency metric, never KoBE alone. The conversational-support domain is explicitly out of scope — 31% zero-entity segments means we'd be selling noise, and I'd rather tell the localization team that plainly now.

Also agreed with Deshawn: the in-house linker build goes into Q3 planning as Obsidian phase 2, since the live candidate-side linking is what unlocks arbitrary customer content instead of pre-annotated sets. Wei, please write the half-page scoping note by Friday so it lands before OKR discussions heat up.

Saoirse — endpoint to prod behind the pilot flag by Thursday, please.

Thanks all,
Priya
